Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source assays, activities, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join assays to activities on assay_id, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217644', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, activities.standard_relation IS NOT NULL. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
